mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.writer_id AS writerId, b.title, b.content, b.file_uuid AS fileUuid, b.created_at AS createdAt, b.updated_at AS updatedAt, u.username AS writer FROM board b LEFT JOIN users u ON b.writer_id = u.user_id ORDER BY b.board_id DESC

SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.writer_id AS writerId, b.title, b.content, b.file_uuid AS fileUuid, b.created_at AS createdAt, b.updated_at AS updatedAt, u.username AS writer FROM board b LEFT JOIN users u ON b.writer_id = u.user_id
AND (u.username LIKE '%' || ${writer} || '%' OR u.name LIKE '%' || ${writer} || '%')
AND b.title LIKE '%' || ${title} || '%'
AND b.content LIKE '%' || ${content} || '%'
ORDER BY ${sort}
ORDER BY b.board_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (writer_id, title, content, file_uuid) VALUES (#{writerId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{fileUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT b.title, b.content, b.file_uuid AS fileUuid, f.original_filename AS originalFilename, b.updated_at AS updatedAt, u.username AS writer FROM board b LEFT JOIN users u ON b.writer_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN files f ON b.file_uuid = f.file_uuid WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId}
